defs.def: more with one person, thing, etc. than with others, or more in particular circumstances than in others 尤其；特别；格外

ex.s: The sun-dried clothes smell especially pleasant where I live, thanks to the ____63____ (absent) of smog and plenty of blue sky ____64____ (afternoon) with lots of fresh air.
ex.t: 在我住的地方，晒干的衣服闻起来格外怡人，这要归功于____63____（没有）烟雾，以及大量充满新鲜空气、蓝天____64____（午后）的时光。

ex.s: It’s ____11____ (peace), especially around sunset.
ex.t: 它____11____（很宁静），尤其是在日落时分。

ex.s: It is a well-known fact, especially in my school, that Junior year is the time of packing many AP classes into the schedule.
ex.t: 介绍Project Debater的设计者。

ex.s: You feel like an 18-year old especially when playing 80s music.
ex.t: 烧烤期间，我把蜂鸟事件告诉了主人。

ex.s: Digital texts, audio and video all have educational roles, especially when providing resources not available in print.
ex.t: 电子文本、音频和视频都有其教育作用，尤其是在提供纸质材料无法获得的资源时。

ex.s: Eating alone, especially in front of the TV or computer, often leads to mindless overeating.
ex.t: 独自进食，尤其是在电视或电脑前，往往导致无意识的暴饮暴食。

ex.s: This training taught her to read and write her Chinese upside down — a skill that has turned out to be quite ____30____, especially whenever we share the newspaper.
ex.t: 这种训练教会了她倒着读写汉字——这项技能后来证明非常有____30____用，尤其是每当我们一起看报纸的时候。

ex.s: Coffee may cause sleep disturbance, especially when _________ in large amounts or after 2 pm.
ex.t: 例如，一条浑浊的小溪流经植物和居住着微小生物的岩石后往往会变清澈。

ex.s: Teaching kids, especially those picky eaters, to cook helps a lot because they’re more willing to eat something made by themselves.
ex.t: 教孩子——尤其是那些挑食的孩子——做饭很有帮助，因为他们更愿意吃自己做的东西。

ex.s: In addition to the problem of miscomprehension from both sides, there are victories accidentally or deliberately twisted, especially when only the victors know how to write.
ex.t: 除了双方相互误解的问题之外，还有一些胜利被无意或有意地歪曲，尤其是当只有胜利者懂得书写的时候。

ex.s: The result is that many communities, especially in farming regions, see solar farms as destroyers of the soil.
ex.t: 结果是许多社区，尤其是农业地区，将太阳能农场视为土壤的破坏者。

ex.s: Most long-distance trains especially the sleeping car accommodations, sell out very quickly. ____36____ But no matter when you travel, it’s a good idea to make your reservations at least 90 days in advance.
ex.t: 大多数长途火车，尤其是卧铺车厢，很快就会售罄。____36____但无论你什么时候出行，提前至少90天预订都是个好主意。

ex.s: I really want to go to a place for the summer vacation, ________ especially with beautiful scenery and unique culture.
ex.t: 故意加入错误有助于学习。

ex.s: Some of our ___41___ are funny, especially from the early years when our children were little.
ex.t: 我们的一些___41___很有趣，特别是早期孩子还小的时候。

ex.s: High conscientiousness is related to lower job performance, especially in simple jobs where it doesn’t pay to be a perfectionist.
ex.t: 高度的尽责性与较低的工作绩效相关，尤其是在那些不需要完美主义的简单工作中。

ex.s: More takeout and more food delivery equal more waste, especially plastic waste.
ex.t: 更多的外卖和更多的食品配送意味着更多的浪费，特别是塑料垃圾。

ex.s: But something about quantum computing makes it especially prone to hype, Johnson suggests, perhaps because “‘quantum’ stands for something cool you shouldn’t be able to understand.” And that brings me back to Taylor, who suggested that I read his book Q for Quantum.
ex.t: 但量子计算的某些特点使其特别容易受到炒作的影响，Johnson暗示道，也许是因为"'量子'代表着你本不该理解的酷东西。"这让我回到了Taylor身边，他建议我读他的书《Q for Quantum》。

ex.s: The call for public engagement with the unthinkable is especially germane in this moment of still-uncontrolled pandemic and economic crises in the world's most technologically advanced nations.
ex.t: 公众参与讨论不可想象之事的呼吁在当今世界最发达的国家仍处于失控的大流行病和经济危机这一时刻尤其相关。

ex.s: The traffic signals along Factoria Boulevard in Bellevue, Washington, generally don't flash the same length of green twice in a row, especially at rush hour.
ex.t: 华盛顿州贝尔维尤市法克托里亚大道上的交通信号灯通常不会连续两次亮相同时长的绿灯，尤其是在高峰时段。

ex.s: “I especially liked the reactions of the parents and the patients when they saw his artwork.
ex.t: 嘿那挺酷的，'"Parry回忆道。

ex.s: Asking a favor of the President of the United States was no casual matter, especially for a seventeen-year-old girl.
ex.t: 那深沉、温和的声音帮助安抚了那个紧张的女孩。

ex.s: As any younger brother will tell you, having a big brother involves a lot of walking in someone else's shadow, especially when you have a brother who is a typical example of "cool".
ex.t: 正如任何弟弟会告诉你的那样，有一个哥哥意味着要经常生活在别人的影子里，尤其是当你的哥哥是"酷"的典型代表时。

ex.s: “It takes a lot for any student，” Whaley explains，“especially for a student who is learning English as their new language，to feel confident enough to say，‘I don’t know，but I want to know.’”
ex.t: "这对任何学生来说都不容易，"惠利解释说，"尤其是对于那些正在学习英语作为新语言的学生来说，要足够自信地说'我不知道，但我想知道'。"

ex.s: If praise is sincere and focused on the effort not the outcome, you can give it as often as your child does something that deserves a verbal reward." We should especially recognize our children's efforts to push themselves and work hard to achieve a goal, "says Donahue, author of Parenting Without Fear: Letting Go of Worry and Focusing on What Really Matters.
ex.t: 专家说赞扬的质量比数量更重要。

ex.s: Especially glbalisation and better communications in the past few decades, all have caused many Languages to disappear, and dominant languages such as English.
ex.t: 尤其是近几十年的全球化和更好的通讯方式，都导致许多语言消失，而英语等主导语言正在日益占据主导地位。

ex.s: There are a lot of benefits to working out, especially in the mornings.
ex.t: 锻炼有很多好处，尤其是在早上。

ex.s: Making Chinese   56  (dish) is seen as especially troublesome.
ex.t: 虽然近年来经常在外就餐似乎对许多年轻人来说变得普遍了，但这并非没有代价。

ex.s: Parents need to limit screen time for themselves and especially for their kids- ___30___ it means playing the bad guy.
ex.t: 父母需要限制自己和尤其是孩子的屏幕时间——___30___（即使）这意味着当坏人。

ex.s: In West Africa, bracelets of bronze or copper were used as cash, especially if the transaction was associated with the slave trade there.
ex.t: 今天，在太平洋的一个岛屿上，一种特定类型的贝壳仍然作为货币——有些人甚至囤积它，就像比特币大亨一样，坚信有一天它会让他们变得富得无法想象。

ex.s: The writing in magazines also tends to be easy to read, especially if it is a children's publication.
ex.t: 全家人一起阅读杂志可以用来介绍彼此拥有的各种兴趣。

ex.s: And it’s especially important for those new to the work force.
ex.t: 对年轻人来说，信息技术技能将在未来发挥越来越重要的作用。

ex.s: When this takes place, especially when a new-born company has no revenue to speak of, the regulators should raise red flags.
ex.t: 当这种情况发生时，尤其是一家新生公司还没有值得一提的收入时，监管机构应当亮起红灯。

ex.s: Around the world, people are adapting in surprising ways, especially in some poor countries.
ex.t: 世界各地的人们正在以令人惊讶的方式适应，特别是在一些贫穷国家。

ex.s: You might think that developing nations would make up the loss (especially since 80% of the world’s people now live in such nations), but you’d be wrong.
ex.t: 你可能以为发展中国家会弥补这一损失（特别是既然世界上80%的人现在生活在这样的国家），但你错了。

defs.def: for a particular purpose, person, etc. 专门；特地

ex.s: Learning idioms can be fun, especially when we compare them to Chinese equivalents.
ex.t: 学习习语可以很有趣，尤其是当我们把它们和中文的对等说法进行比较时。

ex.s: Natural dyes are now returning to popularity, especially with artists and craftspeople.
ex.t: 天然染料如今正重新流行起来，尤其是在艺术家和手工艺人中。

ex.s: This builds strength in your upper body, especially in your arms and back.
ex.t: 这能增强你上半身的力量，尤其是手臂和背部。

ex.s: I use my photography to make an impact on people, especially when it comes to environmental issues Today I've been photographing a crocodile swimming close to our boat, the Kimberley Quest, all day.
ex.t: 我用摄影来影响人们，尤其是在环境问题上 今天一整天我都在拍摄一只靠近我们船——金伯利探索号——游泳的鳄鱼。

ex.s: It made people frightened of sharks, especially of the great white shark.
ex.t: 这让人们对鲨鱼感到恐惧，尤其是大白鲨。

defs.def: very much; to a particular degree 十分；非常
